title: feat(nm2frmrdslz): neighbor-read of cyclic-frame transport at t+1 on two-axis same-lock z-probes: reverse fails, face HOLD
science: Adds the neighbour-read layer to #7494's cell: the ticks, M, O, split, Orient, det and transport rows are identical, neighbour-read HOLDs at B, C and D and fails at A, so reverse fails and face HOLDs unchanged, and the scalar neighbour-read fails at C while the frame neighbour-read HOLDs.
